what: Three-repo structure: aide-v0 (private, all source code), aide-memory/aide-memory (public, README + issues + releases, no source), aide-memory/aide-memory-web (public, Nextra landing page + docs site deployed to Vercel at aide-memory.dev). The web repo should be public — Vercel free tier requires it and it lets people submit docs fixes via PRs.
why: Repo visibility wasn't explicitly stated in the spec for aide-memory-web. Decided public for Vercel compatibility and community docs PRs.
